    "C23-R3-F1 (high): Complete the publication quarantine when recovery metadata is known to be lost. authority/import_v1_domain.rs:305-342 stages only decoded receipts; damaged/unreadable inventory closes the write gate at :404-414 but does not affect v1_hides_tenant or the other read filters. After the first tenant write, damage both receipt copies or make both folders unreadable and relaunch: the staged tenant is published by authority.rs:1611-1625. SelectTenant (:3149-3158) is not in waits_for_import and accepts it because the staged set is empty, issuing an active context before any operator releases the lost record. Direct content reads have the same missing publication boundary. The new D050 exception documents this behavior but does not meet DESIGN.md:2043-2051 or attempt-02 F3's no-partial-publication acceptance condition. Quarantine uncertain data and native authority, or retain an independently recoverable commit binding, until recovery or an explicit operator disposition. Acceptance: in held.rs's both-damaged and both-unreadable scenarios, assert that no uncommitted tenant/content is presented as committed and SelectTenant/direct reads cannot establish authority; preserve preexisting work and make recovery/disposition actionable.",
    "C23-R3-F2 (medium): Do not classify an incomplete receipt inventory as empty and settled. import_v1/receipt.rs:283 maps a missing mirror to Some(empty), while :305 sets unreadable only if both listings are None. With an unreadable primary folder and a missing mirror, ids is empty, unreadable is false and damaged is empty; the authority therefore permits ordinary writes and a new import despite unknown primary records. A missing mirror is also possible with the earlier single-copy schema-1 receipt layout. names additionally drops per-entry read_dir errors via flatten at :274. Preserve uncertainty when the available listing cannot establish the inventory, and propagate listing errors. Acceptance: interrupt an import, remove its mirror, deny access to the primary receipt folder and relaunch; the app must report unknown records and retain the recovery fence. Restoring access must recover without claiming work authored independently in the interim."
  ],
  "blockers": [],
  "evidence_gaps": [
    "C23-R3-G1: The new production-interface tests establish the normal failed-recovery fence and staged-ID refusals, plus successful fallback from one damaged/unreadable copy. The double-fault branches in held.rs check Busy and warning fields but never assert tenant/content visibility or SelectTenant/direct-read refusal before release. They also omit the unreadable-primary/missing-mirror combination. Extend these tests to the acceptance conditions above and protect them with meaningful failure guards.",
    "C23-R3-G2: Bind the affected native regressions and changed recovery UI to this executable. The packet's C01-C22 native records contain 250 passing checks, all against 8be1b95f41b4331bfc4e0dc026b428574a772821a2d68126a494605f0b1db99b, whereas this attempt's executable is 9b0085537a345896aa3d4fdb61b401bb0b2d46e7b10fcb9d5889b59140864c80. The C02/C20 cumulative evidence referenced by reopened-consumers.md is also older in the current C24 records. C23's current eight-check driver exercises the normal import/rollback flow and existing Forget control, not the new damaged/unreadable recovery states and Remove damaged record action. Supply current affected tenant/history coverage and native keyboard/focus/accessibility evidence for those changed states. A source-bound cumulative run may supply the affected coverage without duplicating unrelated historical checks."
  ],
  "optional_suggestions": [],
  "limitations": [
    "Independent read-only review. No application/source edits, build/test reruns, application launches, product endpoint calls or credential access. Findings follow inspected production control flow and inventory semantics; they are not claimed as newly executed runtime reproductions. Only the designated verdict artifact is written.",

The integrated tree includes C24 remediation; this verdict assesses C23.",

The remaining F3 gaps are the uncertainty branches described above.",

Passing guards do not establish the missing uncertainty/publication paths.
